title: Canonical chat history and authority are not contracted
plan_change: Application-canonical bounded history; tool-closed isolated Hermes binding; frozen provider policy

title: Runtime attach, authentication and ownership handshake is incomplete
plan_change: Authenticated stable-root runtime ownership; safe lock recovery; owned/shared lifecycle and component health

title: Crash-safe chat acceptance and dispatch are only an intention
plan_change: Host request journal before send; atomic acceptance; durable reservation; explicit new read attempt only

title: Stream ordering, terminal precedence and cursor recovery are undefined
plan_change: Scoped string-ID sequenced events; snapshots/bounded buffers; terminal CAS and truthful upstream cancellation

title: UI data-fetch and action retry policies are not separated
plan_change: Observation-only retries; command identity cannot be refreshed automatically; unknown effects never ordinary retry

title: Data schema/version and supported downgrade rules need a first-release floor
plan_change: API/schema negotiation, exclusive supported migration and isolated compatible restore start with R1

title: Untrusted Markdown and source-opening policy lacks concrete tests
plan_change: Concrete content/IPC/source-opening deny policy, size limits and negative acceptance

title: Local read consent and provider disclosure consent are not the same grant
plan_change: Freeze provider binding and require both local read and permitted outbound disclosure

title: Forget is not closed over transcripts, caches, pending runs and restore
plan_change: Durable forget barrier, context epoch, pre-barrier chats view-only, purge verification and latest-ledger restore gate

title: Concurrent review and changing context need an atomic decision contract
plan_change: Trusted immutable proposal, atomic competing decision and final scope/version/account checks

title: Connection expiry, reconnect and disconnect lifecycle is underspecified
plan_change: Separate connection/qualification/authority health; immutable account identity and generations; bounded read retry

title: Persisted workflows cannot reuse process-local short-lived grants after restart
plan_change: Templates store intentions; manual/standing authority issues fresh short-lived step references within limits

title: Local task and Google task synchronization rules are absent
plan_change: Local/provider task independence; raw/canonical status and versions; explicit one-time copy; two-way sync deferred

title: A generic receipt pattern does not qualify every external write
plan_change: Provider writes moved to optional R7 modules; per-operation receipts/attribution/reconciliation and conservative stable-account duplicate locks

title: Typed dependency outputs, version pinning and evidence expiry need exact rules
plan_change: Linear maximum-six-step read recipes; pinned versions, typed edges, required inputs and five-minute freshness

title: Cancellation, queue fairness and aggregate budgets are not defined for a run tree
plan_change: Root budgets include all children/retries; bounded queues, foreground priority and retained uncertain accounting

title: DST gaps/folds, overlap and missed-run policies remain choices rather than contracts
plan_change: Daily fixed IANA-zone only; skip gaps/missed, first fold, no overlap/catch-up; unique intended-UTC admission

title: Cron dispatch and application Quit must preserve the same authority
plan_change: Existing scheduler must enter trusted adapter and pass durable app Quit fence; otherwise feature unavailable

title: Skill/plugin update and rollback can change permissions under a saved workflow
plan_change: Reviewed immutable skill/binding versions and effective rights; pinned execution plus live revocation; rollback future-only

title: Memory quality is not established by storage fixtures and one model run
plan_change: Retain hard memory invariants; proposed preregistered 40-case held-out neural suite with at least 38 correct and zero boundary failures

title: Google task due dates are not timed reminders
plan_change: Date-only task semantics remain dates; timed reminders not promised by a task field

title: Old citations may point to expired grants or changed resources
plan_change: Historical retained excerpt differs from temporary artifact and fresh current-source access

title: Event sequence and identifier types can be rounded by JavaScript
plan_change: Opaque IDs/decimal-string counters with existing wire regression and future decoder qualification

title: Attachment limits, parser truncation and temporary-copy retention need user behaviour
plan_change: Qualified UTF-8 text/Markdown first; byte/extraction limits, target/hash checks, partial indicators and tracked cleanup

title: A single runtime-ready label hides different dependency and cold-start failures
plan_change: Component-specific prerequisites and degraded states; no silent empty-root fallback or privileged dependency repair

title: Composer focus outline overrides its own focus-visible design
plan_change: Prototype conflicting outline removed; visible and forced-colour focus rules; rendered verification still required

title: Feature gating applies to navigation but not inspector or sample conversation
plan_change: One generated manifest governs routes, samples, inspector and attachments; direct unsupported intents denied

title: Narrow layout hides the sidebar with no reopening path
plan_change: Prototype native navigation dialog with real open/close/Escape and live focus fallback

title: Wide inspector does not obey the show/hide toggle
plan_change: Prototype actual wide visibility plus narrow dialog and synchronized aria-expanded/labels

title: IME Enter is treated as submit
plan_change: Prototype composition latch/event/key229 guards; normal Enter and Shift+Enter remain distinct

title: Optional subreleases and optional W37 lack machine-readable gate status
plan_change: Explicit feature variants, required-when-advertised cases, exclusion reasons and mandatory omitted-capability denial

title: Web research and knowledge/notes roles have no concrete delivery slice
plan_change: Live web research and external notes explicitly deferred; no misleading model-only substitute

title: The full W01-W47 to concrete runtime binding catalogue is not reconciled
plan_change: All 47 IDs inventoried; unresolved bindings remain unavailable until developer reconciliation; no invented prompts

title: Transcript, drafts, run artifacts and logs have different deletion/storage pressure behaviour
plan_change: Record-class retention, pending privacy barriers, quotas and truthful disk-full state; expired command namespaces prevent pruned replay

title: Quick-window position, hotkey conflicts and close/reopen recovery are untested
plan_change: Quick view shares broker/draft lease; clamped bounds, hotkey conflict, tray restore and private notification rules

title: Build/runtime version matrix is not resolved for the selected host
plan_change: Pinned host/build/runtime/license matrix and no-go gates before implementation; no automatic runtime upgrade
